message.subject: Re: Motor bracket HB: two quotes
message.body:
Dear Kantteile Strasser team,

We are glad to have you with us on the Motor bracket HB, and we would like to keep filling your capacity with this part in a way that works for both family companies.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you a clear, firm unit price and payment terms that are simple to plan around, and it sits well against the points below.

On quality:
Your quality was 762 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70360@2026Q3).

On a competing offer:
Another supplier has offered EUR 17.19 for this part (offer:70340-0).

On our price history with you:
Our orders of Motor bracket HB with you were placed at EUR 16.11 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011516-10), EUR 16.11 on 2025-06-05 (po:4500012559-10), EUR 16.11 on 2026-01-20 (po:4500013462-10) and EUR 16.11 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014435-20): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 14.31; payment 45 days net; lead time 42 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 14.36; payment 60 days net; lead time 42 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 14.46; payment 90 days net; lead time 42 days.

Options B and C are genuine alternatives if longer payment terms matter more to you than the unit price. Our focus is on Option A, and we would like your best answer on it.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
